page0.text:
Nothing changes in the afternoon.
I take her to every shop I can think of, and Saber follows quietly.
At least it's not as awkward as earlier in the morning.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page0:1

page1.text:
Either I'm getting used to the situation, or Saber's given up.
She's still quiet, but the more I watch her, the more I notice she looks either angry...or not angry, which is really confusing.
Whenever I see Saber coming out of a store looking excited, I feel this sense of accomplishment. It really makes me happy.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page1:1

page2.text:
Then...
...after a careful consideration of what Saber might like...
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page2:1

page3.text: ...I'm not certain, but I determine this is the shop most likely to please Saber.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page3:1

page4.text:
"Gh—!?"
Saber stands in front of the store, mouth agape.
I'm not sure if her shoulders are trembling because she's angry or excited... I just can't tell.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page4:1

page5.text:
"Sh-Shirou...where are we?"
"I hear this is the biggest stuffed animal shop in town. I've never been here, since men aren't allowed."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page5:1

page6.text:
Obviously, it's not that men aren't allowed in the store.
It's just that most of the customer base are girls, so there's this unspoken rule about men not going inside.
Besides, there are only girls in the store right now.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page6:1

page7.text:
Saber, with her beautiful blonde hair is drawing attention, while I'm drawing glares for being a guy.
They must all be trying to keep me out of their sanctuary.
And I can't agree more.
Even I don't think guys should be in a store like this.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page7:1

page8.text: "Well, we've come all the way here, so don't hold back. Let's take a look around. Do you have a favorite animal, Saber?"
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page8:1

page9.text: "Uh...well. I suppose I find lions and leopards to be quite lovely... Do you find that strange?"
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page9:1

page10.text:
"Uh..."
I find myself turning away and fighting not to laugh.
I'm not sure why Saber liking lions is strange.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page10:1

page11.text: "Shirou. Your reaction does not seem right. It fills me with an inexplicable sense of rage... Or is it my imagination?"
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page11:1

page12.text: "Uh, no...sorry. I couldn't help but laugh. A lion is just so perfect for you."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page12:1

page13.text:
"What!? I-it is not right to laugh at someone's preferences, Shirou! And there is nothing wrong with lions!"
"And I said I'm sorry. To make it up to you, I'll take you somewhere good, so don't get mad."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page13:1

page14.text:
I try to fight down my laughter and walk in to the store.
Let's see...looks like animal stuffed toys are over there.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page14:1

page15.text:
And...
It takes about an hour to get from one end of the store to the other.
I watch in silence as Saber stares at the stuffed animals while I worry about the dozen or so sets of prying eyes staring at me from around the store... I've never been so exhausted in my life as I am today.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page15:1

page16.text:
The terrifying thing is that we've only made it through half of the store.
Saber frequently is paralyzed...that is, she often stops and stares at a stuffed animal. Even after all this time, we're only halfway through the store.
Saber seems very interested in the other half of the store, so I guess I'll just hang around while she does what she wants here.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page16:1

page17.text: "Shirou? Why are you sighing? Are you tired from walking so much?"
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page17:1

page18.text: "Hmmm? Yeah, I'm just a little tired. I usually don't get tired so easily, but today's special. I guess I should be careful about doing things I'm not used to doing."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page18:1

page19.text:
I heave a sigh.
I don't mind people staring at us when we're just walking around, but I'm uncomfortable with it when we're in this girly shop.
When you're mentally drained, the first part of your body that feels it is your legs.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page19:1

page20.text: "What about you, Saber? This must be your first time in a store like this. Let me know if you get tired."
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page20:1

page21.text:
"Yes, I am a little uncomfortable, but you look far more so. Not only here. You did not seem comfortable in the previous shop, or the one before that...
I hope you are not selecting places you do not wish to go?"
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page21:1

page22.text:
...
Suddenly...
Those words dispel all the worries and mental exhaustion I felt earlier.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page22:1

page23.text: "Yeah. Honestly, I might have chosen a bunch of places I wouldn't normally go."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page23:1

page24.text: "I knew it. That is ridiculous, Shirou. You are aware of your own dislike, so why would you purposefully go there? You will..."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page24:1

page25.text:
"It's the sort of place girls like, right?
I was the one who made you come out with me, and it's your day."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page25:1

page26.text:
...
"Besides, it's not so bad, since you're with me. I'm with a beautiful girl, so I don't look completely out of place...all the stares directed at me aside."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page26:1

page27.text: "Th-that is absurd! I may not be armed, but I am still a Servant. Even if I am not fighting, you need not treat me like a woman. You must treat me as a Servant, like always."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page27:1

page28.text: "You're the one being absurd. You are a girl. I'm not trying to treat you differently today... Unless you feel like I am."
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page28:1

page29.text:
"Ah..."
She's bewildered.
Saber's mouth hangs open, as if she's only just now realizing this.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page29:1

page30.text:
"No, you are the same.
You are acting the same as you always do."
"See? No need to worry about me.
So let's keep going. If we're going to buy your favorite thing in here, we still have to see the other half of the store."
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page30:1

page31.text:
I take Saber's hand.
She offers no objection as I tug her along.
"Oh, that is right. It has always been like this. I do not know why I'm realizing this now..."
She murmurs to herself, sounding dazed.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十四日目-07:page31:1
